# Table { #anylumino.Table }

```python
Table(
    rows=(),
    columns=None,
    *,
    row_key=None,
    selected=(),
    selects='',
    sortable=False,
    sort_key='',
    sort_direction='',
    quiet=False,
    emphasized=False,
    density='',
    select_all_label='Select all rows',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Display structured data in a Spectrum table.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type     | Description                                                                                                             | Default             |
|------------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------|
| rows             | optional | Table rows as mappings, sequences, or scalar values.                                                                    | `()`                |
| columns          | optional | Table columns as strings, ``(label, key)`` pairs, or dictionaries with ``key``, ``label``, ``sortable``, and ``align``. | `None`              |
| row_key          | optional | Optional row mapping key used as the stable Spectrum row value.                                                         | `None`              |
| selected         | optional | Selected table row values.                                                                                              | `()`                |
| selects          | optional | Selection mode: ``'single'``, ``'multiple'``, or empty for no selection.                                                | `''`                |
| sortable         | optional | Whether all table columns are sortable unless a column overrides it.                                                    | `False`             |
| sort_key         | optional | Current table sort column key.                                                                                          | `''`                |
| sort_direction   | optional | Current table sort direction, either ``'asc'``, ``'desc'``, or empty.                                                   | `''`                |
| quiet            | optional | Whether to use Spectrum's quiet visual treatment.                                                                       | `False`             |
| emphasized       | optional | Whether selected table rows use Spectrum emphasized styling.                                                            | `False`             |
| density          | optional | Table density, either ``'compact'``, ``'spacious'``, or empty for the Spectrum default.                                 | `''`                |
| select_all_label | optional | Accessible label for the table select-all checkbox.                                                                     | `'Select all rows'` |

| [sort_key](#anylumino.Table.sort_key) | A trait for unicode strings. |
| [sortable](#anylumino.Table.sortable) | A boolean (True, False) trait. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [append_row](#anylumino.Table.append_row) | Append one raw row and return the normalized row value. |
| [on_select](#anylumino.Table.on_select) | Register or unregister a callback for table selection changes. |
| [on_sort](#anylumino.Table.on_sort) | Register or unregister a callback for table sort changes. |
| [prepend_row](#anylumino.Table.prepend_row) | Prepend one raw row and return the normalized row value. |
| [remove_row](#anylumino.Table.remove_row) | Remove an existing row by row value. |
| [set_rows](#anylumino.Table.set_rows) | Replace table rows from raw row mappings, sequences, or scalar values. |
| [update_row](#anylumino.Table.update_row) | Update cells for an existing row by row value. |

### append_row { #anylumino.Table.append_row }

```python
Table.append_row(row, *, row_key=None)
```

Append one raw row and return the normalized row value.

### on_select { #anylumino.Table.on_select }

```python

```

Register or unregister a callback for table selection changes.

### on_sort { #anylumino.Table.on_sort }

```python
Table.on_sort(callback, remove=False)
```

Register or unregister a callback for table sort changes.

### prepend_row { #anylumino.Table.prepend_row }

### remove_row { #anylumino.Table.remove_row }
